gate.title: Grown-ups only
gate.body: Solve this to leave the game.

handover.title: Now let {{name}} play
handover.body: Hand over the device and sit nearby. Keep the sound on — the guide talks. No need to help with the answers.
handover.soundHint:
Keep the sound on
for the best experience

guide.title: Who do you want to explore with?

world.intro: Hi! I'm {{guide}}. I'll be your guide on our adventure.
world.introScreening: First, let's visit the oasis and play the picture game!
world.today: Today's quest is waiting. Tap the glowing spot!
world.allDone: You finished today's quest. See you tomorrow, explorer!

screening.intro: I'll show you pictures. Tell me what you see!
screening.again: Oops, I didn't hear well. Say it again?
screening.noMic: No microphone? Tap here to continue
screening.doneBody: You earned {{count}} stars. Now give the device back to your grown-up.

quest.warmupIntro: Let's warm up! Breathe with me.
quest.soundIntro: Hide your tongue behind your teeth and say a long “sssss” like me!

retry.interdental: Let's try with teeth closed — tongue hiding inside.
retry.dentalized: Pull your tongue back a tiny bit, behind the teeth.
retry.lateral: Let the air go out of the middle, like a straw.
retry.palatal: Bring your tongue a little forward, near the teeth.

quest.tap: Tap the mic and say it
quest.doneBody: You earned {{count}} stars. {{guide}} is so proud of you!
